goodNotes.tracker-verified: Every local file is the tracker's file, byte for byte.
goodNotes.no-duplicate-cells: No two cells share an identical count row.
goodNotes.barcodes-in-ids: Every cell ID carries a barcode-length run of bases.
goodNotes.encodings-supported: Every dataframe uses an encoding the tools read and write.
goodNotes.raw-counts-clean: No negative, non-finite or fractional values in the count matrix.
goodNotes.embeddings-clean: No NaN, constant or wrongly shaped embeddings.
goodNotes.required-uns-present: Required dataset metadata in uns is present.
goodNotes.donor-sex-agrees: Expression agrees with the annotated sex for every donor the check could call.
goodNotes.compressed: Matrices are stored with gzip compression.
goodNotes.source-metadata-agrees: Where object cells could be compared with their source, no metadata field differs.
goodNotes.default-embedding-set: uns['default_embedding'] names an embedding that exists.

issueNotes.forbidden-ethnicity-column: obs carries self_reported_ethnicity_ontology_term_id, which HCA forbids for privacy. strip_forbidden_obs_columns removes it.
issueNotes.gene-annotation-version-unknown: Some cells declare gene_annotation_version as 'unknown'. The producer has to say which Ensembl or GENCODE release each part of the data used.
issueNotes.placeholder-library-preparation-batch: library_preparation_batch holds the placeholder 'unknown'. It has to become a missing value, which replace_placeholder_values does.
issueNotes.placeholder-library-sequencing-run: library_sequencing_run holds the placeholder 'unknown'. It has to become a missing value, which replace_placeholder_values does.
issueNotes.joined-library-sequencing-run: library_sequencing_run holds comma-joined lists of lanes and flowcells. Each value must be one identifier, so the producer has to say how to split them.
issueNotes.cap-missing: No CAP annotation sets, and the tracker has no CAP link for any object. The tracker's cell-annotation validator fails every object on this.
issueNotes.cap-decision: No CAP annotations and no CAP link on the tracker. For a source dataset this is information until a wrangler decides whether the study goes to CAP.
issueNotes.donor-sex-mixed: Several Tucker donors carry a real sex and 'unknown' on different cells, so the donor-sex check refuses to run. The reports give the fill value for each donor.
issueNotes.development-stage-mixed: Donor AH1 carries a real development stage on some cells and 'unknown' on others.
issueNotes.labels-not-populated: No var['feature_name'] and none of the derived obs labels. populate_labels fills them in one step during curation.
issueNotes.matrix-uncompressed: The matrix is stored without compression. compress_h5ad fixes it, and it runs last in a curation sequence.
issueNotes.library-id-na: library_id holds the literal text 'na' on many cells. The validator doesn't flag it, but it looks like a placeholder; ask the producer.
issueNotes.source-partition-incomplete: Most object cells match two source datasets or none, so only a small share was compared. See the note on any object page.
issueNotes.unused-categories: Some categorical obs columns keep categories no cell uses. populate_labels clears them.
issueNotes.default-embedding-unset: uns['default_embedding'] is not set. set_uns sets it.
issueNotes.study-pi-missing: uns['study_pi'] is missing, which the tracker's schema validator rejects.
issueNotes.study-pi-not-list: uns['study_pi'] is a single string where the schema wants a list.
issueNotes.normalized-x-missing: X holds raw counts and there is no normalized matrix. normalize_raw writes one.
issueNotes.donor-sex-unknown: Every cell's sex is 'unknown' for some donors; the expression gives a clear call the wrangler can confirm.
issueNotes.gene-ids-not-in-gencode: Gene IDs outside GENCODE v48 are atlas-team work: the producer has to rename, drop or explain them, class by class. The Gene identifiers table at the bottom gives each file's counts.

lede: All 16 integrated objects and 29 source datasets were evaluated read-only against the tracker's copies. 4 of the integrated objects and 9 of the source datasets are publish ready. The count matrices are sound almost everywhere. What holds the atlas back is a short list of metadata problems shared by most files, plus CAP for the integrated objects.
